Laguna Tools is hiring a full-time, on-site Junior Web Developer to support marketing technology, online sales, and the customer experience. The role works with the IT/Marketing Manager and marketing team to build and maintain website features, troubleshoot issues, and support integrations and related digital tools.
Manufacturing
Retail
Wood Processing
No H1B
Responsibilities
Build and update website pages, product information, forms, and features in coordination with our IT/Marketing Manager and marketing team
Write, test, debug, and maintain code for our website and related digital tools
Troubleshoot website issues, including broken pages, links, and forms, and help maintain reliable content and features
Test website changes across common browsers and devices, contributing to usability, accessibility, and performance improvements
Support website integrations with other systems and automate routine tasks when assigned
Document changes, track work, and follow established security and version control practices
Assist with other programming and IT projects, communicate progress, and escalate complex issues

Required
Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, plus experience with at least one programming language through coursework, projects, or work experience
Ability to read existing code, troubleshoot problems, and learn unfamiliar platforms and tools
Experience with WordPress and WooCommerce
Familiarity with ERP systems
Familiarity with Git or another version control tool and basic testing practices
Strong attention to detail, organization, and communication skills
Ability to manage assigned tasks, meet deadlines, and collaborate with colleagues outside of IT
Associate or bachelors degree in computer science, software development, information technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
Experience with a content management system, e-commerce website, APIs, databases, or basic automation scripts
Ability to provide a portfolio or examples of work
Candidates in the DFW area and surrounding communities
